policy: Every remaining apparently unscoped query is classified; unresolved legacy ownership is fail-closed rather than guessed.

findings.evidence: Director scope is required; user, attendance, admission, payment, fee, faculty, batch and attempt paths use institution relations. Security-readiness aggregate endpoint is fail-closed for Directors.
Tenant actors are scoped through assigned user or Admission.instituteId; unassigned legacy leads are excluded.
Target-role notifications require matching instituteId; institutionless users receive only direct notifications; email log access requires scope.
Delivery records are tenant-scoped; global queue and WhatsApp audit totals are withheld from tenant actors.
Report sources include legacy unowned/raw aggregate records; tenant actors receive 403 until source ownership is proven.
Timetable has no authoritative institution relation and remains unavailable with 403.
Legacy routes still expose global lead/admission aggregates and require a dedicated actor scope review.
